title: Wind force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the horizontal wind force as 6 N.

title: Rope tension magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the rope tension as 10 N.

title: Vertical balloon equilibrium
description: Important: Applies vertical force balance to the balloon (buoyancy = weight + T cosθ).

title: Horizontal balloon equilibrium
description: Important: Applies horizontal force balance to the balloon (wind = T sinθ).

title: Normal force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the normal force on the box as 82 N.

title: Friction force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the friction force as 6 N.

title: Vertical box equilibrium
description: Important: Applies vertical force balance to the box (Mg = N + T cosθ).

title: Horizontal box equilibrium
description: Important: Applies horizontal force balance to the box (friction = T sinθ).

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for tension components or misassigns force directions.

title: Unit omission
description: Pitfall: Fails to include units (N) with final numerical answers.
